prompt.zh-TW: 下面三個項目，哪一個在現行做法下屬於資本公積？
prompt.en: Which of the three items below belongs in capital surplus under current practice?

text.zh-TW: 發行新股時，股東付的價格超過面額的部分
text.en: The amount shareholders pay above par value when new shares are issued

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。股本溢價是資本公積最典型、也最常見的來源。
feedback.en: That is right. The share premium is the most typical and most common source of capital surplus.

text.zh-TW: 今年營業賺到、還沒分配的本期淨利
text.en: This year’s profit from trading that has not yet been distributed

feedback.zh-TW: 你知道它會留在股東權益裡，這部分正確。不過賺來的盈餘累積在未分配盈餘，不是資本公積；兩者來源不同，用途的限制也不同。
feedback.en: You are right that it stays in equity. But earned profit accumulates in unappropriated retained earnings, not capital surplus; the two have different sources and different restrictions on use.

text.zh-TW: 賣掉一台舊機器賺到的處分利益
text.en: The gain from selling an old machine

feedback.zh-TW: 較早的分類方式確實把這類利益列為資本公積的來源（{{raw:2001}} 年修正前的公司法），但那是舊制。現行 IFRS 把處分不動產、廠房及設備的利益列入當期損益，不進資本公積。
feedback.en: Older classifications did treat this kind of gain as a source of capital surplus (the Company Act before its {{raw:2001}} amendment), but that is the old system. Under current IFRS a gain on disposal of property, plant and equipment goes to profit or loss, not to capital surplus.

explanation.zh-TW: {{option:o_p4q5}}是現行最常見的資本公積來源。{{option:o_r6s7}}屬於未分配盈餘；{{option:o_t8v9}}在舊制分類下曾列資本公積，現行準則把它列入當期損益。
explanation.en: {{option:o_p4q5}} is the most common source of capital surplus today. {{option:o_r6s7}} belongs to unappropriated retained earnings; {{option:o_t8v9}} went to capital surplus under the older classification, but current standards put it in profit or loss.
